task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the content of ~/Desktop/artemis_relay_reqs.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent configures the Spacecraft and GroundStation in GMAT with Luna as the central body.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT GUI showing the Spacecraft 'Orbit' tab with 'Central Body' set to 'Luna' and GroundStation configured at the South Pole.

task_completion.description: Agent sets up a ContactLocator resource to detect line-of-sight between the spacecraft and the ground station.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT resource tree showing a 'ContactLocator' object and its configuration window targeting the Spacecraft and GroundStation.

task_completion.description: Agent runs the mission sequence to propagate the orbit for exactly 7 days.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT Mission tab showing a 'Propagate' command with a duration of 7 days (604800 seconds) and the execution log showing a successful run.

task_completion.description: Agent generates or opens the contact report to find the longest contact duration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text file or GMAT output window showing a list of contact intervals with start/stop times and durations.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the GMAT script to the specified output directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File explorer or terminal showing 'artemis_relay.script' exists in ~/GMAT_output/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the summary analysis file with the required four lines of data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command output showing ~/GMAT_output/relay_summary.txt with SMA_km, ECC, INC_deg, and max_continuous_contact_hours.

integrity.description: Agent used the GMAT graphical user interface for configuration rather than just writing a script via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the GMAT application window being interacted with (menus, resource trees, dialog boxes).

integrity.description: Agent calculated the SMA based on the 12-hour period rather than guessing.
integrity.visual_evidence: Calculator app, python terminal, or scratchpad showing the math: SMA = cuberoot(mu * (T / 2pi)^2).

integrity.description: The values in relay_summary.txt match the data generated in the GMAT contact report.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'max_continuous_contact_hours' in the text file matches the longest interval shown in the GMAT report screenshot.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The correct Semi-Major Axis (SMA) for a 12-hour lunar orbit is approximately 6128.5 km (calculated using T=43200s and mu=4902.8). The contact report must be derived from a 7-day propagation. The summary file must contain exactly four lines with the specific labels: SMA_km, ECC, INC_deg, and max_continuous_contact_hours.
